contract: Each v0.10 Shield integration/e2e test binds one minimal contract-deviation counterexample (mutation) and a kill verification, per test-plan section 1.5 and the test-review TEST-3 criterion. 28 patches were authored against the current tree and all 28 were executed as apply -> run-bound-test -> observe-FAIL -> revert (result=killed), including counterexample implementations that make an absent v0.10 surface exist with contract-violating semantics. AC-NFR0155-01's discriminating surface is the ui test asset itself (the scan target is delivered by M-IMPL), and the ui-journey tests' discriminating surfaces (workbench shell/static app) are contract-reserved for M-IMPL, so the 22 bindings whose discriminating surfaces do not exist at M-TEST carry the mutation specification with result=pending-implementation for materialization at M-TEST re-entry; patches are fail-closed checked (git apply --check) and touch no product behavior beyond the stated mutation. Count correction 2026-09-28: this header previously restated 24 executed kills / 4 pending bindings (a stale mid-authoring count); the binding records below are the per-item authority and record 28 killed + 22 pending-implementation.
